column1: # SCISSORS sample table, consumed by scripts/02_count.sh
#   output_id     Cell Ranger --id and output directory name. This is the name
#                 the R analysis expects; the `ids` vector in
#   fastq_sample  Cell Ranger --sample, i.e. the sample prefix in the FASTQ
#                 filenames, which is the Sample_ID column of SampleSheet.csv.
#   fastq_dir     The fastq_path directory produced by stage 1.
# Rows with fastq_dir set to TODO are skipped with an error by 02_count.sh.
# Only the Mock_5h row could be recovered from the pre-restructure script; the
# rest need filling in from your mkfastq output directories. See README
# fastq_sample values are inferred by dropping the _PV suffix, which is the
# relationship the recovered Mock_5h row shows (id Mock_5h_PV, sample Mock_5h).
# 02_count.sh verifies FASTQs actually exist for the prefix before counting,
# so a wrong guess fails immediately rather than producing an empty matrix.
